subject: english
stem:
At first, the extra rules seemed troublesome. After one week, however, players said the game was fairer and easier to follow.
Which summary keeps the right focus?
options: More rules always improve every game
Players found the game less fair
Players came to see benefits in the new rules

optionRationales.reason: The rules first seemed troublesome：只保留初始感受。
More rules always improve every game：一週個案不能推成 always/every。
Players found the game less fair：與 fairer 相反。
Players came to see benefits in the new rules：however 後的使用後評價修正初始負面印象。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「轉折標記後的修正、限制或作者真正採納的立場」可推出 Players came to see benefits in the new rules；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Players came to see benefits in the new rules 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
